about: Known layer violations (tests/test_layers.py). Every entry needs a reason and the ROADMAP task that removes it. The lint fails on a new violation and on an entry whose violation is gone: this list only shrinks.

allow.reason: creatureApply is the one writer of a creature record's table pointers (it replaces the init* bodies); a World accessor would only wrap the same store
